rule: Hand corrections to a book's lemma+POS records, applied by book_ingest.load_lemmas on every read. The tagger's output on disk is never edited, so a book id still names one occurrence set; what the dictionary treats as the book's vocabulary is the tagger's records with these corrections on top. A record is merged into the record it belongs to, or dropped, and each line says why and who found it. 'checked' lists records a reader called artifacts that turned out to be right: they stay.
